title: StylusZeppelin
tagline: A Rust Crate for secure smart contract development For Arbitrum Stylus
description: StylusZeppelin is a  Rust crate tailored specifically for secure smart contract development on Arbitrum Stylus, the next-generation layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum. Inspired by the OpenZeppelin library, StylusZeppelin empowers developers with robust tools and battle-tested patterns to build reliable and audited smart contracts with ease.
how_its_made: StylusZeppelin sets a new standard for secure smart contract development on Arbitrum Stylus, offering a comprehensive suite of tools and utilities crafted entirely in Rust and leveraging the full capabilities of the Stylus SDKs. Designed as a Rust crate, StylusZeppelin empowers developers with a robust and efficient framework to build secure smart contracts with ease.
